summary: PR #17 directory layout is doctrine-compliant. evidence/debate/pr-17-F*-r{1,2}.json and pr-17-synthesis.json conform to the consensus_debate_protocol template <change_id>-<reviewer>-r{1,2}.json (specs/cross-cutting/multispectrum-review.json:279,291,304). The pr-N change_id form is sanctioned: the change_id schema (line 123-125) is free-form string with no regex constraint, and the doctrine's own example (line 347) mixes shapes (claude-F1_linus-CC-1-kernel-public-api-2026-05-14). The audit-chain.jsonl append and registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl writes are also canonical paths.

findings.issue: change_id schema is unstructured 'type: string' with no pattern/regex constraint. Doctrine therefore cannot reject either pr-N or M02-P06-FOUNDRY-SUPERVISOR-2026-05-15 forms; the mixed-shape change_id space is permitted by omission rather than by explicit sanction. This is a doctrine gap, not a PR #17 defect.
findings.remediation: Add a change_id pattern (e.g., enum or regex covering pr-<int>, M<NN>-P<NN>-<SCOPE>-<DATE>, F-LANE-<TOPIC>-<EPOCH>) in a follow-up doctrine PR. Out of scope for A3 reject.

rebuttals_to_premise.premise: Per ADR-0115 - registries/cross-cutting/ retired in favor of registry/. Why does PR #17 still write to registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl?
rebuttals_to_premise.evidence: docs/decisions/ highest ADR is ADR-0114-canary-observability-rollback.md; ADR-0115 does not exist. Doctrine still mandates /registries/cross-cutting/fixuptasks.jsonl in specs/cross-cutting/oyatie-doctrine.json:131,183 and specs/cross-cutting/root-hub-pointers.json:237 and docs/AGENTS.md:63. registry/ exists as a separate tree (accounts/, adr/, audit-chain/, capabilities/...) but does not host fixuptasks. PR #17 writes to the canonical doctrine-sanctioned path.
rebuttals_to_premise.if_adr_0115_is_planned: Open a separate doctrine-migration PR; do not retroactively penalize PR #17 for following the spec in force on 2026-05-16.

rebuttals_to_premise.premise: Is pr-N an acceptable change_id form?
rebuttals_to_premise.evidence: multispectrum-review.json:123-125 declares change_id as free-form string; line 347 example itself uses a hyphenated multi-token form. The filename pr-17-F1-r1.json fits the <change_id>-<reviewer>-r1.json template at line 279.

scope_lens: A3 directory-layout only; F-family substance lenses out of scope.
